title: ChatGPT recommends our competitor by name. What can we actually do?

comments.text: Same. Asked it for 'best payroll software for UK charities' and it named Brightwell Systems three times. We're bigger than them.
Look at where the model gets its facts: your own site, directory listings, review sites, and press. If your positioning isn't written down clearly anywhere, the model has nothing to repeat.
We fixed the wrong description it gave of us within a month by rewriting our about page and the G2 listing. No agency.
The moment that got budget approved was screen-recording the CEO asking ChatGPT and watching it recommend the competitor. Nothing else worked.
Posted by Tom Harrington, we're at 200 staff and this is now a board level topic.
